question: Protected-object selection and verified object absence
alternatives: Explicit predeclared sets including targets; distractor-only sets; automatic selection. Verified absence as NA versus invalid intended scope. Empty set rejected versus explicit empty scope.
recommended_alternative: Explicit finite canonical set, no count restriction or LLM selection; reject duplicate IDs/aliases resolving to the same instance. Empty scope retained and excluded from metrics. Closed-roster absence yields object NA plus scope-mismatch flag; exclusion never silently repairs a study protocol.
subdecisions: D01.a RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: selection, duplicate rejection, empty-scope accounting. D01.b RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: absence policy with separate experiment eligibility. D01.c BLOCKED_ON_EVIDENCE: actual closed-roster/alias certificate.
scientific_justification: Requirement quantification must be fixed before outcomes are known; nonexistence differs from failed detection. Scope mistakes cannot create safety evidence.
engineering_justification: Canonical identity resolution and protocol eligibility are separate from object outcome; deterministic validation avoids name/count-dependent logic.
safety_definition_consequence: Targets may be protected if predeclared. Verified absent rows remain NA, not safe instances; all configured rows retained.
v4_consequence: Configuration handles 0/1/3/5/other counts; duplicate canonical config IDs rejected before assessment; duplicate resolved aliases fail binding. Unknown presence stays U.
v3_compatibility: Historical five-member set and denominators unchanged. New absence exemption and empty-scope reporting require separate V4 condition.
evidence_required: Source-bound scene roster complete at t0, canonical/native alias map, geometry/model identity and frozen selection manifest; preregister absence eligibility.
risks: Cherry-picked scope, roster incompleteness and alias collisions; absence exemption can inflate apparent coverage if eligibility is hidden.
implementation_readiness: Specify now; structural implementation after approval. Empirical absence cannot be enabled merely by schema success.

question: Multiple surfaces, movement and indirect support
alternatives: Fixed initial root; explicitly designated union; separate per-surface requirements. Static-only versus moving/articulated surfaces. Direct support versus certified indirect or multiple-parent support.
recommended_alternative: Initial scope: multiple independently bound static surfaces across an execution; explicit S(o), with designated static union as the requirement meaning. No inferred surface addition. Implement direct and finite acyclic single-parent indirect chains only through admitted profiles. Defer handoff/dynamic/multiple-parent inference.
subdecisions: D02.a RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: static surfaces and declared union. D02.b RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: capability-gated single-parent indirect support. D02.c DEFER: moving/articulated roots, dynamic handoff and multiple-parent inference. D02.d BLOCKED_ON_EVIDENCE: staticness and each chain inference profile.
scientific_justification: Union semantics distinguish leaving one designated surface from leaving the designated support system. Staticness and load bearing must be demonstrated, not inferred from an ID.
engineering_justification: Separate semantic capability declaration from adapter capability admission; support multiple roots without needing general dynamic load solving.
safety_definition_consequence: Continuous qualified support within the designated union is not a fall. A handoff not evaluable by the initial profile remains unknown, never an implicit safe transfer.
v4_consequence: Resolve each root and all collision pieces, verify static transform evidence on the relevant domain; unsupported root motion => IC for affected claims; unresolvable local transitions => U. No world-wide IC for unrelated objects.
v3_compatibility: Singleton table mappings preserve intent, not output equivalence. Historical omitted ID15 and table binding remain untouched; corrected V4 mapping separately evaluated.
evidence_required: Per-root model hashes, collision geometry, transforms/staticness evidence; admissible contact semantics and chain validation; separate analytical union fixtures.
risks: Unobserved surface motion, unseen alternative supports, cycles, incomplete geometry and hidden dynamic load redistribution.
implementation_readiness: Revise release scope now, then implement static structural resolution after approval; empirical support admission remains gated.

question: Exact hazard/temporal witness
alternatives: Any departure; any unsupported flight; unsupported downward falling departure; robot-caused fall; include versus exclude post-lift drops.
recommended_alternative: Keep verified unsupported downward falling departure from initial designated support, without a cause/intention/floor requirement. Retain established lift/carry exclusion. Separate containment and post-grasp drop/release requirements; no new implementation of those requirements here.
subdecisions: D03.a RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: narrow hazard and handling exclusion. D03.b RECOMMEND_REVISIONS: explicit interval-boundary/censored-episode language in amendment A03. D03.c BLOCKED_ON_EVIDENCE: gravity-relative translation, origin and load-bearing handling witnesses.
scientific_justification: Different hazards need different labels and denominators. Intent does not determine mechanics: established carrying excludes a later drop, but intentional pushing could still cause an R1 fall.
engineering_justification: Keep physical episodes separate from applicability and scope tags. Avoid root-height or descending-vertex shortcuts that mistake rotation for falling.
safety_definition_consequence: A later catch cannot erase an admitted in-scope fall. Loss before t0 is not a new in-interval departure. Onset or falling evidence straddling a boundary is qualified/U, not negative.
v4_consequence: Track loss, downward phase, handling and origin brackets separately. Do not require ballistic acceleration or a landing. An uncertain handling exclusion cannot suppress or confirm a fall.
v3_compatibility: Preserves historical hazard intent and lift exclusion; gravity/translation witnesses differ from world-z all-vertex inference, so V4 labels need new versions.
evidence_required: Identity-continuous poses, validated gravity/transforms and reference point, geometry/support-loss evidence, handling evidence when exclusion applies, clock uncertainty and interval brackets.
risks: Narrow R1 misses harmful post-lift drops by design; temporal association cannot establish causation; sparse observations can conceal a short fall.
implementation_readiness: Approve semantics now with A03; implement analytical scope logic only after approval. Empirical positive claims blocked until witness profiles validated.

question: Handling episode end, re-placement and non-designated handoff
alternatives: Permanent post-lift termination; automatic re-arming; explicit new applicability epoch; conservative unresolved suffix.
recommended_alternative: Retain initial applicability and never auto-rearm. Preserve a verified excluded carry/drop episode. At verified re-placement or non-designated supported handoff, subsequent unresolved R1 scope stays U unless an earlier admitted violation already determines the object result. Defer new epochs and complex handoffs.
subdecisions: D04.a RECOMMEND_REVISIONS: distinguish known excluded drop from unresolved post-replacement suffix (A04). D04.b RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: no automatic restart and positive preservation. D04.c DEFER: re-arming, permanent termination alternatives, complex handoff/re-support logic.
scientific_justification: Excluding a specific established handling episode does not prove all later motion outside the requirement. Re-placement introduces an origin/scope question, not renewed initial support by fiat.
engineering_justification: Use scope states and explicit unresolved intervals; do not reset a detector on every recontact or erase a previously established fall.
safety_definition_consequence: An initially unsupported object stays NA under this execution requirement even if later placed. An initially applicable object may become unresolved after re-placement, not retroactively NA.
v4_consequence: Output initial applicability, excluded episodes, re-placement evidence and unresolved suffix independently; whole-domain negative fails when the suffix is unresolved.
v3_compatibility: Historical abstention for unresolved re-placement preserved. Permanent exclusion or re-arming would change claim scope and require another version.
evidence_required: Evidence for the handling episode, recontact/re-placement and scope boundary; do not assume contact alone establishes new stable support.
risks: Conservative loss of coverage; falsely declaring episode termination can hide a later fall; catches must not erase earlier violations.
implementation_readiness: Amend text before implementation; exclusion/unknown bookkeeping can follow approval. Complex resupport remains deferred.

question: Multi-object execution aggregation
alternatives: Any valid violation first versus global IC first; any-object applicability versus all-object shortcut; scalar-only versus full vector.
recommended_alternative: Preserve complete object vector and counts. Primary outcome: admissible violation, else affected essential IC, else U, else qualified negative over applicable objects with others NA, else NA. Empty scope explicit/excluded. Configuration-invalid input has no assessed result.
subdecisions: D05.a RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: vector, precedence, empty eligibility. D05.b RECOMMEND_REVISIONS: distinguish input rejection from object IC (A01). D05.c RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: report evidence completeness independently of primary violation.
scientific_justification: R1 is universal prevention: one sound counterexample refutes it even if another object is unknown. Unknown unrelated objects cannot turn a sound violation into safety, nor may they support a negative.
engineering_justification: Deterministic precedence with scoped invalidity and separate completeness avoids hiding object findings in a global scalar.
safety_definition_consequence: One NA never exempts other objects. A positive is local evidence of a violation, not complete knowledge of all objects. Unknown can change a negative to a violation and therefore prevents full negative.
v4_consequence: Aggregate only admitted object outcomes; global identity/time foundations that invalidate a positive remove its admission before precedence. Report counts and eligibility alongside scalar.
v3_compatibility: V3 had per-object outputs; execution-level aggregates have no historical accuracy baseline. Never substitute execution denominators for old per-object metrics.
evidence_required: Analytical truth tables for mixed outcomes plus source-dependency isolation proof/tests; no new physical calibration for aggregation itself.
risks: Users may mistake violation-plus-incomplete for complete execution evaluation; invalidity isolation can be wrong if shared foundations are overlooked.
implementation_readiness: Can finalize now with A01 and approved dependency rule; implement pure aggregation after approval, no empirical performance claim.

question: Initial V4 capability/evidence and boundary-inference profile
alternatives: All LIBERO/benchmarks versus explicit recorder/model/task bindings; BOX/static versus general geometry; state-first versus vision-only; direct-only versus certified chains; snapshot versus boundary-context inference.
recommended_alternative: Start with existing LIBERO recorded-state schema, hash-bound rigid BOX geometry and static horizontal support roots, direct and admitted single-parent chains. Known task00/01 evidence is development provenance, not validated all-task coverage. Saved-frame domain only. Cameras conditional. Boundary context cannot move t0 or erase early events.
subdecisions: D06.a RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: bounded initial capability declaration. D06.b RECOMMEND_REVISIONS: distinguish mathematical fixture mode, legacy comparison and empirical profile (A06). D06.c BLOCKED_ON_EVIDENCE: recorder state/contact phase and support-profile validity. D06.d DEFER: vision-only, other benchmarks, generalized shapes/dynamics.
scientific_justification: Configurable names do not establish recorder semantics or new-scene validity. V3 static-equilibrium reasoning is an inference with assumptions, not measured support force.
engineering_justification: Versioned adapter admission prevents inherited table/native-ID defaults. Metadata resolves per-execution settling and time; no fixed count10 in the new core.
safety_definition_consequence: Narrow evidence capability, not narrower abstract object-count semantics. Unsupported essential geometry => IC; missing data under a supported profile => U.
v4_consequence: Separate validated facts from inference profiles; new model/XML IDs require fresh binding. Legacy stencil -1/0/+1 allowed only as explicitly exposed comparison/development profile until admitted for empirical use.
v3_compatibility: Reuse schema knowledge without editing V3 or treating its nominal lag and arithmetic allowance as calibration. Prior cohort remains exposed development regression only.
evidence_required: Producer/recorder version, XML and complete geometry inventories, state/transition timing, contact producer semantics/completeness, boundary phase and independent profile checks; raw restoration only if required fields unavailable.
risks: Missing HDF5, camera exposure unknown, cached state/contact phase, omitted geometry and inference leakage from NV cases.
implementation_readiness: Contracts/fixture mode may begin after approval/amendments; no general empirical adapter certification yet.

question: Calibration, tolerances, persistence and alignment
alternatives: Invent fixed thresholds; inherit V3 roundoff/lag as physical calibration; independently bound uncertainty; defer claims requiring missing calibration.
recommended_alternative: No empirical numerical defaults. Preserve null as unknown. Use justified uncertainty bounds and explicit alignment dependencies; threshold-overlap yields U, unsupported essential calibration model IC. Separate arithmetic error from physical/recorder error. No minimum fall duration/distance exemption.
subdecisions: D07.a RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: no-default/fail-closed policy and separate arithmetic uncertainty. D07.b BLOCKED_ON_EVIDENCE: geometric, pose, state/contact phase and camera calibration where required. D07.c DEFER: empirical hysteresis/persistence policy until sensitivity/detection-limit evidence exists.
scientific_justification: A tolerance changes which observations are distinguishable; it must not silently redefine the physical hazard or be tuned to improve the exposed cohort.
engineering_justification: Carry calibration provenance/validity by channel and interval. Unknown optional camera phase does not block an independent valid state witness; essential unknown phase does.
safety_definition_consequence: Short or small falls remain hazards even when the detector cannot resolve them. Unresolved evidence produces abstention, not semantic exemption.
v4_consequence: Do not enable empirical witness profiles without their required calibrated bounds or a justified exact recorded-state contract. Analytical exact inputs may test logic, not certify simulator physics.
v3_compatibility: Do not reinterpret 512-epsilon arithmetic bounds, nominal 0.002-s lag or 0.05-s cadence as new validated physical settings. Frozen V3 unchanged.
evidence_required: Recorder code/order and tests, event/state phase bounds, units/transforms/gravity/shape uncertainty, independent calibration protocol and held-out checks; camera exposure only for claims using images temporally.
risks: Unbounded physical uncertainty, false precision, cohort-tuned thresholds, persistence suppressing true short events; restoration cannot recover never-recorded timing.
implementation_readiness: Policy can be approved now. Empirical parameters and profiles remain blocked; infrastructure and symbolic fixtures do not require fabricated calibration.

question: Negative-domain composition and partial reporting
alternatives: No detected fall as negative; mandatory single modality; union of any available data; claim-qualified witness cover with bridge/transition obligations.
recommended_alternative: Require explicit negative/exclusion certificates over the requested saved-state domain. Union only admitted same-claim cells with compatible identities, clocks, profiles and scope; overlaps neither double count nor provide independent corroboration by themselves. No gap filling. Initial release static-negative profile only; defer dynamic/handling negative composition.
subdecisions: D08.a RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: claim-specific coverage algebra and whole-domain U for holes. D08.b RECOMMEND_REVISIONS: make cross-source compatibility/contradiction checks explicit (A08). D08.c DEFER: moving-support and carry/post-lift negative composition. D08.d BLOCKED_ON_EVIDENCE: admission of actual negative certificates.
scientific_justification: Absence of a candidate is not evidence of absence. Two sources copied from one simulator cache are dependent; even independent sensors need temporal compatibility before their evidence composes.
engineering_justification: Represent cells and provenance dependencies instead of merging numeric intervals blindly. A boundary between qualified windows must itself be covered if the domain includes that transition.
safety_definition_consequence: Saved-frame negatives claim only that projection, never continuous safety. Partial clear windows retained but whole claim U. A valid positive needs no full negative coverage.
v4_consequence: Available/decoded/inspected/admitted/negative domains separate. A known carry exclusion can be recorded without certifying the whole domain as negative.
v3_compatibility: V3 static negative windows remain as sealed. Broader compositional coverage is a new V4 condition, not improvement on historical 4/5 without separate evaluation.
evidence_required: Per-cell certificate, shared clock/identity/phase bounds, source dependency graph and overlap conflict tests; admitted support profiles for every negative cell.
risks: Smooth plots and overlapping indices hide transitions; falsely independent derived exports inflate confidence; coverage-driven cohort tuning.
implementation_readiness: Coverage algebra ready after proposed revision/approval; empirical qualification blocked; dynamic/exclusion coverage deferred.

question: Mapping failures and missing-versus-invalid precedence
alternatives: Single unknown class; IC erases all findings; any positive signal wins; dependency-scoped admission with distinct missing/contradictory/invalid records.
recommended_alternative: Distinguish missing observations U, unresolved admissible conflicts U, and foundational unsupported/incompatible contract IC. Isolate invalidity by evidence dependency. Only a positive surviving its own identity/applicability/scope/contract checks enters aggregation; common-foundation contradiction suspends admission.
subdecisions: D09.a RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: dependency-scoped validity and strong positive admission. D09.b RECOMMEND_REVISIONS: formalize unresolved conflicts and diagnostic-only input rejection (A01/A09). D09.c BLOCKED_ON_EVIDENCE: resolution of actual contradictory sources.
scientific_justification: A positive counterexample is decisive only if sound. Majority agreement or a weak visual cue cannot repair a broken identity, clock or geometry foundation.
engineering_justification: Persist all conflicting records and adjudication status, with explicit affected-claim edges; do not delete a sensor or choose a favorable label to remove conflict.
safety_definition_consequence: An unrelated missing optional camera cannot erase a sound measured fall. A credible same-event contradiction can challenge witness admission and must not be dismissed by positive-first aggregation.
v4_consequence: Perform contract/conflict admission before object outcome and aggregation; configuration failure rejected with assessed=false and null assessed outcome. Preserve U/IC distinctions and reasons.
v3_compatibility: V3 merged several failures into insufficient information; new distinctions change accounting and require versioned comparison, never relabeling old outputs.
evidence_required: Dependency graph, producer/hash/clock identity checks, analytic contradictory-witness fixtures and documented investigation criteria for empirical conflicts.
risks: Incorrectly calling a correlated conflict unrelated can create false positives; overbroad invalidation causes avoidable abstention; hash failure is not evidence of physical absence.
implementation_readiness: Amend before implementation. Pure precedence/conflict state machine can follow approval; unresolved real conflicts remain blocked.

question: Empirical validation/reference design
alternatives: Reuse exposed NV cohort for confirmation; natural-only evaluation; controlled-only evaluation; separate natural and controlled strata with disjoint development and held-out sets. AI-only versus independent human-confirmatory references.
recommended_alternative: Plan two separately reported strata: untouched natural executions and controlled, provenance-bound falsification scenarios. Predeclare object/support/interval scopes and split by source execution/seed/task/scene families to prevent sibling leakage. Include independently verified applicable positives, negatives, NA and uncertain cases.
subdecisions: D10.a RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: separate strata and honest reference provenance. D10.b RECOMMEND_REVISIONS: prospective sample/split/metric protocol before data acquisition. D10.c BLOCKED_ON_EVIDENCE: positive/negative references and independent review. D10.d DEFER: any new experiment execution in this task.
scientific_justification: Natural prevalence and controlled detection sensitivity answer different questions. No confirmed positive in the old cohort means no empirical recall estimate; AI consensus is not independent human truth.
engineering_justification: Freeze inference/profile versions before opening held-out references; link all object rows from a run to one partition and disclose cross-scene versus same-scene holdout.
safety_definition_consequence: Dataset labels must use this versioned R1, including initial applicability, handling and coverage; task failure or a post-lift drop is not automatically an R1 positive.
v4_consequence: Later evaluation reports applicability, conditional outcome agreement, abstention/coverage, class confusion, localization only where identifiable, and clustered uncertainty. Report undefined denominators as null.
v3_compatibility: NV01-NV20 stay exposed exploratory/development material with their old seals and counts. Do not tune thresholds on them and claim a fresh held-out test.
evidence_required: Separately authorized natural-candidate audit/controlled protocol; preserved originals, independent physical evidence review, adjudication, locked splits, sample-size/precision targets and reference provenance.
risks: Simulated perturbations alter construct/ecology; spectrum and selection bias, correlated objects/runs, reviewer/model dependence, leakage and positive scarcity.
implementation_readiness: Approve study principles now; protocol details and new experiments require separate approval. Empirical validation is not ready.

question: Configuration and adapter certification
alternatives: JSON conformance as certification; ad hoc adapter acceptance; versioned structural plus capability/empirical admission. Single version versus separate requirement/evidence/adapter/checker/profile identities.
recommended_alternative: Keep independent versions and hashes for requirement, configuration schema, evidence schema, adapter, inference profile, checker and calibration. Capability tests establish bounded conformance only. Empirical validation scope/status is separately documented, not a self-asserted validated_contract flag.
subdecisions: D11.a RECOMMEND_APPROVAL: independent version/provenance and capability gates. D11.b RECOMMEND_REVISIONS: proposed schema amendment A11 before runtime use. D11.c BLOCKED_ON_EVIDENCE: empirical capability records. D11.d DEFER: additional benchmarks, vision-only and unsupported geometry certification.
scientific_justification: Structural admissibility and physical validity are different claims; a hash authenticates bytes, not truth or generalization.
engineering_justification: Runtime resolves and verifies external capability/calibration records and scope, not merely nonempty certificate strings. Deterministic refusal for unknown versions/essential capabilities.
safety_definition_consequence: Abstract arbitrary objects/counts do not certify their dynamics, materials or observation contract. Declarations never bypass abstention/IC.
v4_consequence: Add reviewed profile/evidence/checker version fields in a future revised schema or signed manifest binding; reject release-incompatible modes; retain immutable comparison namespaces.
v3_compatibility: Historical schema/config and seals unchanged. New version separation is additive and separately evaluated, not a migration of historical approval.
evidence_required: Analytical capability matrix, source/model/frame/clock binding tests, replay/tamper tests, scoped validation records with evidence links and calibration validity.
risks: Certificate laundering, inconsistent version combinations, parser acceptance mistaken for certification, unsupported cross-benchmark claims.
implementation_readiness: Contract design ready after amendment/approval; runtime conformance infrastructure may follow. Empirical certification remains blocked.
